# ListActionRow

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:list-action-row` · Kerf UI · component · Navigation

Configurable navigation rows with structured labels, status/busy metadata, density, group dividers, and sibling primary/trailing native-button actions.

## When to use

Keep a selectable primary row action and an independently named trailing action as sibling native controls inside one noninteractive visual row.

- A navigation or item row needs both a primary selectable action and an independently focusable trailing action.

**Not when:**

- Use ListItem when trailing content is dormant metadata; use AppTab only for tablist semantics and ToolbarControlGroup only for toolbar controls.
- Do not inject declaration strings; use className, public tokens, and cataloged component props for application styling.

**Alternatives:**

- [ListItem](./list-item.md) (nearest) — Trailing content is noninteractive.
- [AppTab](./tabs.md) (semantic alternative) — The primary control selects a tabpanel inside TabBar.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/list-action-row` — exports `ListActionRow`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/list-action-row` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/list-action-row.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/list-action-row`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuilist-action-row) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- selected
- pressed
- disabled primary
- disabled trailing action
- multiline
- placeholder (loading)
- compact density
- description and status
- busy while retaining content
- interaction-revealed trailing action
- before, after, or paired group divider

**The app owns:** routing; selection; action handling; domain data attributes; popover or context-menu policy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: navigation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- The noninteractive root contains two sibling native buttons in primary-then-trailing focus order; each button has its own action, item identity, accessible name, and disabled state.
- Selection semantics are exposed only by the primary button; label, icon, and trailingActionIcon are dormant SafeHtml and must not contain interactive descendants; never place an interactive descendant in ListItem.trailing.
